threshold_source.note: specs/tech-architecture/e23-TEST_PLAN_LATEST.md does not exist and TEST_PLAN_LATEST.md is empty (0 bytes); the only declared thresholds for this story are the ones its own spec states.

performance.threshold: a membership test on the declared list, measured rather than bounded: nothing in the code caps its length
performance.measured: 0.000009 ms per decision, worst case (10 entries, no match, full scan), 1e6 iterations after warmup
performance.note: The decision is taken twice per intervention — at requireCapable and again at run — since the chokepoint guard was added. An earlier reading of this story claimed one traversal; that stopped being true and the verdict is restated on the measured cost, not on the traversal count.

reliability.threshold: a refusal starts 0 processes, emits 0 bytes and opens 0 interventions; failure direction is closed
reliability.measured: probed=[] and started=[] asserted by test/v1/egress.test.ts on refusal; test/v2/egress-refusal.test.ts drives a real harness and asserts no intervention event; three input classes refuse (unknown provider, empty declaration, malformed declaration) and exact-equality comparison cannot over-match. An empty provider_id is deliberately not judged here — it is a model never configured, and the capability check names it on its own terms.
reliability.note: A refusal is journaled as a change.block with stop reason policy_denied, like every other refusal. An earlier reading of this story claimed no event was written; that was true of the supervisor in isolation and false of a harness driving a change.

operability.threshold: the refusal is readable in every qualified Pi entry and names what to correct
operability.measured: POLICY_DENIED carries category 'policy' and stop reason 'policy_denied', both preexisting. The refusal is marked retryable, so the block lifts on resume once the destination is declared, and next actions name declare_egress_destination ahead of the preexisting configure_model. The message names the refused destination and the declared list, or names the declaration as empty.
operability.note: No new presentation component; the refusal rides the existing diagnostic path.
